tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi smin grol 'bogs pa'i bklag chog ḍā kī'i 'dzum zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /spros med chos sku'i mkha' dab
༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi smin grol 'bogs pa'i bklag chog ḍā kī'i 'dzum zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /spros med chos sku'i mkha' dab

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi smin grol 'bogs pa'i bklag chog ḍā kī'i 'dzum zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

spros med chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las/ /'gags med rigs lnga'i yum gyi gar/ /dbyer med bde chen rgyal mo la/ /g.yo med 'dud do srid 'di srung*/ de la 'dir mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga la sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la sbyor ba yo byad kyi shom ni phyi nang gi mchod pa dkar bgegs sta gon rdzas bzhi sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams 'du bya/ cho ga'i sbyor ba la sa lha/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ thog mar tshig bdun dang brgyud 'debs/ rgyun khyer ltar bdag gi rnal 'byor nyung bsdus bzlas pa bsdu ldang bcas sngon du 'gro ba'am brgyud 'debs 'phros su bdag nyid skad cig gis lhar gsal bas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon gyi rnam pa cir yang 'char bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa mgron spyan drangs/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri bā ra na ma sarba nas/ ghṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā de swā hā/ sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐: dgongs shig dzaṃ gling sa la mnga' mdzad pa'i: sa yi lha mo brtan ma la sogs pa: sa bdag klu gnyan zhing skyong tshogs rnams dang : khyad par yul 'dir gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: 'dod yon mchod spyin bzang po 'di bzhes la: bdag gis gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor bgyid 'tshal bas: ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: dge zhing phan pa'i stong grogs sgrub pa dang : sa phyogs dge zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol: zhes phrin du gsol bas sa'i lha mo gtso mos gnang ba byin zhing dgyes pa chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas sa gzhi la thim pas sa phyogs bkra shis byin chags gzi 'od 'bar bar

bsam: bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ sa 'khor rnams rang rang gi gnas su dgyes bzhin tu gshegs shing dge ba'i stong grogs mdzad par bsam la gtor ma dang gser skyems phyi rol du mchod/ gnyis pa lha sta gon ni rgyas par spyi ltar byas kyang chog mod/ 'dir thun mong min pa'i lugs ltar na gshom bkod kyi spros pa mi dgos pas/ bdag nyid khros ma'i skur gsal ba'i: thugs nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: gsang ba kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha: mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gyur: oṃ: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed pa dang : slob ma rnams la snying brtse bas: gnas 'dir mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi: pho brang chen po 'debs 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te gnang ba dang : snod bcud byin gyis brlab mdzad gsol: lan gsum gsol btab rab dgyes pas/ rdo rje slob dpon snying rje che: khyod kyis rang gzhan phan gdags phyir: sgrub pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin gyis: bde gshegs rgyal bas byin rlob 'gyur: gnang ba stsal nas 'od du zhu: bdag dang gnas la thim pa yis: tha mal snang zhen rab sbyangs te: ye shes chen pos byin brlabs bsam: zhes gsal gdab/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ gsang ba'i bum pa thod pa mtshan ldan chang la bdud rtsi lnga btab pas bkang ba stegs bu'i dbus su bkod/ phyi nang gi mchod pas bskor la byin brlab/ thod pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dha'i snod dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje khros ma nag mo/ phyogs bzhir snying po'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi/ de rgyab gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ phra men dang dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dwangs ba'i mtsho la zla skar shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/

ces dmigs/ mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kyis: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs mchod: bzhes nas dam skong dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba dz+nyā na dhā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā: ma hā pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las rnam 'phrul sa gsum khyab par snang : las dang ye shes dngos grub thogs med stsol: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: gzungs thag blangs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te lha rnams la phog pas bde ba chen po'i rjes chags bskul/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi ye shes kyi bcud du 'khyil bar gyur/ ces mos la gtso 'khor rnams kyi snying po ji ltar 'os pa bzla sa mthar/ lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang dbyer med par gyur/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed bzlas spyi ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ so shing*/ dpung skud sngon po/ dung chu/ ku sha'i phon po che chung*/ nyer spyod lnga rnams bdog /slob bu dad pa dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems gnyis kyi blo 'byongs pa/ dam tshig srung bar nus nges pa'i rigs can rnams sgrub khang gi sgo drung du khrus bya/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin/ nang du 'ong nas las byang ltar bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgoms la phyogs mtshams bcings shing gral du 'khod/ chos zab mo bshad pas blo bcos par gsungs pas spro na rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ kye skal ba dang ldan pa rnams nyon cig: dal 'byor gyi lus rten 'di ni rnyed dka' la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin pas chud ma zos par snying po len dgos:

snying po gang gi sgo nas len na dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa la brten nas len dgos: chos de yang le lo dang phyi bshol du ma song bar da lta lag len du btab dgos: de ltar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na: skyes tshad thams cad 'chi ba'i chos can dang : 'chi ba chos nyid las ma 'das: 'chi ba de'ang nam 'ong cha med: shi ba'i tshe lus longs spyod mdza' bshes sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang bar rang gcig pu las kyi phyi bzhin du 'gro bas da lta nyid du 'chi chos gsha' ma zhig bya dgos: chos kyi rtsa ba'ang las 'bras la rags las pas mi dge ba'i las thams cad dug bzhin tu spang : dge ba'i las sman bzhin du bsten nas spang blang phyin ci ma log pa zhig bya dgos: de thams cad kyang nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa thar lam gyi rtsa ba yin pas 'khor ba mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin me yi 'obs lta bur mthong nas de las thar pa'i slad du lam la bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa shugs drag tu bskyed dgos: de lta bu'i blo sbyong gi rim pas lam gyi gzhi things par gyis shig: de'ang thar pa'i lam la slob pa'i tshul dang 'jug pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa las 'dir rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos tshul thams cad kyi mthar thug rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab bla na med pa rtsa ba gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs rnams kyi nang nas phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rgya mtsho lta bur bzhugs pa las gsang chen zab mo'i mthar thug /snying po las kyang snying po'i yang zhun du dril ba/ rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum mchog rdo rje phag mo gtso bor gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba thams cad yongs su 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing rgyud smin par byed pa la/ thog mar snod nye bar bsnyen pa slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug /me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes pa'i yum: bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas: bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas: dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug mdzad gsol: lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pa la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dbyer med pas dri ba stsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed cag su yin ci yi rigs: dad ldan dam tshig srung nus sam: zhes dris pa'i lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag cag skal ldan theg chen rigs: dkyil 'khor gtso bo slob dpon dang : gsang ba'i tshul la shin tu dad: rdo rje'i dam tshig srung nus so: zhes gsol ba btab pa la slob dpon gyis gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ de ltar yin na gsang mchog gi: dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa la: nye bar bsnyen pa'i cho ga yis: lhag gnas rim pa tshul bzhin bgyi: zhes gnang ba byin nas spy-ir khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud rnam par dag cing sdom pa gsum la nye bar bsnyen pa'i slad du/ thog mar theg pa che chung thams cad kyi 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa bzung dgos pas/ bla ma dang rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang bar sad pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bdag dang khams gsum 'gro ba kun: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: rtsa ba gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum ngang du gnas gyur cig: lan gsum/ mkha' khyab kyi pha ma sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i slad du gsang ba kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zab lam la rnal 'byor du bgyi'o snyam pas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bdag gis sems can thams cad rnams: sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i phyir: mkha' 'gro ma yi bskyed bzlas dang : mchod bstod sgrub la brtson par bgyi: lan gsum/ bsags sbyong spel gsum gyi don rnams re re bzhin gsal thob la tshig 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan bla ma la: sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: lus dang longs spyod ltos med mchod sprin 'bul: sdig ltung dam tshig nyams chag mthol zhing bshags: zag bcas zag med dge la rjes yi rang : snying po don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: rtag par mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba kun: 'gro rnams bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo: lan gsum/ de nas phyi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ nang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa/ gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams ngo bo gnas 'gyur ba bzung*/ yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul gyis bsrung*/ dus skabs dgos pa gang gtso thad kar spyad par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ho: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir: so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba dang : byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang : rig 'dzin gsang sngags sdom pa'i tshogs: tshul bzhin bzung zhing bsrung bar bgyi: lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud rnam par dag par byed pa'i rim pa rnams song nas thun mong du dngos grub kyi gnas la nye bar bsnyen pa ltas brtag pa'i don du so shing 'dor bar gsungs pas thog mar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i so shing de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi phyag tu phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hrī: sor brgyad so shing gtsang ma 'di:

dngos grub rim pa brtag pa'i phyir: mtshan ma'i maṇ+ḍal dbus su dor: dge ba'i sems kyis rtogs par gyis: zhes gtad pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyis mkha' dbyings kyi phyag rgyas bzung ste so shing gi ra bar sngags 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te 'dor bar zhu/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha: sid+dhi sid+dhi ku ru ho: zhes pas 'dor du gzhug /so shing rtse mo gang du bstan pa ltar dngos grub 'grub pa'i tshul yang gzhung las/ steng du mkha' spyod 'og sa spyod: rang dang slob dpon mchog dngos te: phyogs bzhir las bzhi mtshams rnams su: rtse bstan dngos grub ci rigs 'grub: ces gsungs pa ltar lags so/ /bye brag tu sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag cing bar chad srung ba'i phyir du thog mar lus la rdo rje'i sngags mdud gdags pa ni/ oṃ bam̐ badz+ra bha rā hi kro dhi kā li ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya gu h+ya dz+nyā na bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha hūm̐ hūm̐: lan bdun gyis brlab/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab pa'i srung ba'i skud pa de nyid skyes pa rnams kyi dpung pa g.yon dang bud med rnams kyi g.yas su gdags par mdzod cig /oṃ: bcom ldan bde gshegs mkha' 'gro ma'i: sku yis byin brlabs sngags mdud 'di: slob ma'i lus la btags pa yis: rgyud dag bar chad srung gyur cig: badz+ra kā ya bi shud+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha rak+ṣa haṃ: zhes bcings la mdud pa'i steng dri chab gtor cing rdo rje'i rgyas gdab/ des ni lus rtsa yi nyes pa dag cing khams 'pho ba dang rmi lam gyi bar chad srung zhing sku sgom pa'i snod rung du sgrub pa'o: dung zhal gyi chu la/ oṃ ni pad+ma dhā ki nī hrī: lan bdun bzlas/ gnyis pa lce la bdud rtsi'i khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ āḥ bcom ldan pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i: gsung gis byin brlabs bdud rtsi 'diḥ slob ma'i lce la byin pa yis: rgyud dag rmi lam gsal bar shog: badz+ra wā ka bi shud+dha pra kā sha phaṭa:

zhes pas byin pa'i chu des kha lan gsum bshal nas lhag ma rgyab tu dor bar zhu/ des ni ngag rlung gi nyes pa dag cing rmi lam gsal ba dang sngags bzlas pa'i snod rung du sgrub pa'o: ku sha'i phon po che chung la/ oṃ ha badz+ra dhā ki nī hūm̐: zhes lan bdun gyis brlab/ gsum pa rdo rje thogs pa med pa'i rdzas ku sha'i chun po che chung dag byed kyi rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas g.yon du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i: thugs kyi byin brlabs thogs med rdzas: slob ma'i gdan du byin pa yis: yid sgrib dag cing gtsang bar shog: badz+ra tsit+ta bi shud+dhe a pra ti ha ta swā hā: ku sha'i phon po chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du gyis la do nub bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gus pa dang ldan pas nyal nas rmi lam gyi mtshan ma brtag dgos pa lags/ des ni yid mtshan ma dang rnam rtog gi nyes pa dag cing rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang thugs kyi ye shes 'char ba'i snod rung du sgrub pa'o/ khyad par gzhi lus dang sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan rdo rje khros ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum/ khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug phyar zhing g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ gru mo g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khyud cing ral pa dmar nag gyen du brdzes pa'i rna ltag g.yon par phag zhal ngur sgra sgrogs pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ zhabs brkyang bskum gar thabs kyis pad ma nyi ma bam ro'i gdan la 'gying zhing ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

sku'i sngags/ oṃ bam̐ badz+ra bhā ra hi kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa a bai sha ya: gsung gi sngags/ oṃ bam̐ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni yai ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: thugs kyi sngags/ oṃ bam̐ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa:zhes pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dri'i thig le khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bkod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gdod nas dag pa gnyug ma'i khams: shin tu phra ba'i lus ngag yid: rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mchog dang : gnyis su med par byin brlab bo: kā ya badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na oṃ: wāk+ka badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na āḥ tsit+ta badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na hūm̐: de ltar gzhi lus gdod ma'i lha skur rdzogs shing sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi phyag rgyas btab pa la mchod pa'i sprin gyis mnga' dbul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ nyer spyod re re bzhin 'bul la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra nai bid+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod de bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ me tog 'thor te/ skye med chos sku'i yum chen kun tu bzang*/ /'gag med longs spyod yongs rdzogs mkha' 'gro lnga/ /dbyer med sprul pa'i rnam rol mtha' klas pas/ /'gro khams sku gsum rtsal rdzogs bkra shis shog /de dag gis mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi smin byed dbang gi sngon tu 'gro ba'i slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa tshul bzhin tu grub pa lags pas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo bar zhu/ zhes dge bsngo byas la slob ma rnams gyes pas sta gon gyi rim pa rnams grub/ ༈ /gnyis pa dbang gi dngos gzhi sgrub pa la/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi shoms ni/ gnas khang rgyan bkod byi dor byas pa'i gung du gzhung mthun gyi sku rten bkram pa'i spyan sngar stegs bu'i dbus su ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i steng sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mtshon byed mañji'i khar gsang bum bhan+dha mtshan ldan bla med bum rdzas so lnga dang*/

ma da na bzang po'i bdud rtsis bkang ba'i khar sin+dhu ra'i rdul gyis sbags pa'i me long chos 'byung gi dbus su sa bon bam̐ yig la sku gsung thugs sngags kyi yig mgo phyir bstan du bskor bas bkab pa'i steng rang byung gi shel rdo rnams brtsegs pa dar dmar gyis bkab/ mdun du mkha' 'gro sde lnga dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi phra men bzhi dam tshig mkha' 'gro bzhi bcas kyi tsaka li bshams/ mig dar/ me tog /rdo rje'i chu nan/ dpal 'bar/ me long g.ya' dag /mda' gzhu/ gtso mo'i sku tsaka /mar me/ sngags phreng*/ dung*/ glegs bam/ dur khrod rol pa'i chas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ rig tsaka /rdo rje me long bcas dang*/ shar phyogs su mañji'i khar rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i chu skong bum pa mgul chings dkar po chu snas bkang ba kha rgyan bcas dang*/ lho phyogs su rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sats+tsha dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga bcas lnga/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i me skong la las kun lhun grub kyi me thab bud shing las bzhi'i dbyibs kun tshang bar brtsigs shing me skong las 'byung ba ltar sreg rdzas tshang ba/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro'i rlung skong la/ spos snod gcig gi nang du gzhung mthun gyi rdzas bye brag pa so so dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos tshom bu lnga bkod pa dang rlung g.yab bcas bzhag /rdo rje phag mor mar me'i skong ba zhun chen dang chos sman gyis spag pa'i mar me lnga tshoms/ mkha' 'gro yongs rdzogs mdos kyi skong ba mdos skong las 'byung ba ltar mdos rdzas ldan pa'am/ bsdu na mtha' lcags ris bskor ba'i dbus su bang rim bzhi steng mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma gtso 'khor lnga la so so'i mdog mthun gyi nam mkha' btsug /bang rim rnams su mtheb kyu 'bru sna dar sna rnams dang*/ bkra shis rdzas rtags bya rigs gcan gzan chu gnas nyi zla sogs zan spar btab pa dang*/ lcags ri la nam mkha' mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong rgyang bu btsug pa dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang bder bkod/

sman dbang gi don du phyogs gang bder thod pa ril bus bkang ba dar dmar gyis bkab pa yang bshams/ phug logs su gtor dbang gi don du gtor ma ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su mkha' 'gro ma'i dpal gtor phra la brjid cing phag mgos mtshan pa pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma'i dpal gtor chung ngu re/ bang rim 'og ma gsum la phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo zung 'jug gi gtor chung nyer bzhi/ rtsa bar las dang dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor chung brgyad/ bar mtshams rnams su theb kyu gang mang dang*/ sha khrag 'bru sman sgog btsong la du la phug myos byed sogs kyis bskor/ dkar gyis thig gdab/ dmar gyi gur phub/ dar gdugs dang bris skus brgyan pa bsham/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshe dkyil dang*/ mda' dar/ tshe 'brang*/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril bcas dang*/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro'i nor dkyil dang*/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs can mtha' nor bu mig gsum pa mang pos bskor/ rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan bkod dar ser po'i gdugs can dang*/ g.yang chang mda' dar sogs phywa g.yang gi rten rdzas ci rigs/ thod pa dum bu gcig pa'am gsum pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sman sna lnga dang bdud rtsi chen pos byug phywa g.yang gi rdzas kyis phyur bur gtams la thod pa'i 'khor lo nor sgrub las 'byung ba ltar bris pa gzhug pa bcas dang*/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i dbang sdud las 'byung ba ltar so so'i rdzas dang ldan pas sku'i rten bris sku/ gsung gi rten srog 'khor/ thugs kyi rten mtshan ldan ban+dha'i snod du dbang gi ril bu bcas bsham/ gzhan yang sreg las kyi rjes gnang gi ched du stegs bu dmar po zla gam la dbang gi thab tshul bzhin bris/ tsan+dan dmar po'am mdzo mo shing lta bu'i dmar zhing skyur ba'i bud shing brtsig la ting lo dmar po'ang bzhag

/dgang gzar blugs dang nye logs su sreg rdzas mar khu dang*/ dmar skyur gyi yam shing*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo ril bu'i rdzas dang sbyar ba'i mngar gsum gyi ril bu dmar po/ me tog lcags kyu can ma da nas sbags pa/ lan tshwa bcas dang*/ spra tshil lam zan las bcos pa'i dmigs bya'i liṅga/ sbyin sreg la phul rgyu'i tshogs dang bdud rtsi bcas thams cad kha dog dmar po snum bag dang ldan par bsham/ byang du karma mkha' 'gro'i zor dkyil dang*/ hom khung du liṅga gzhug /de'i steng du zangs lcags kyi snod du dbus su zor gtor khro mo'i zhal can dang phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi de rgyab phyogs mtshams gyi phra men brgyad de gtor chung lha grangs/ de rgyab zor kong zur gsum brgyad la/ shar du yungs kar/ lhor rtsang*/ nub tu dug /byang du rdo/ shar lhor me/ lho nub dug khrag /nub byang mda'/ byang shar phung sa'i zor rnams bkod/ 'tshe nyungs sha khrag gis brgyan cing*/ dar nag gi gdugs phub la/ g.yas g.yon du/ sngags byang dang*/ gnam lcags rdo rje bzhag /phyag rgya bzhi'i chas/ hom dang liṅga/ byad thag /dug khrag /bsgral phur/ rtse gsum/ gri gug /thod ngan du khrag thun sbyar ba rnams dang drag po'i rol cha sogs rngams shing 'jigs zil dang ldan pa 'du bya/ gzhan yang dam can spyi gtor/ bka' srung spyang bzhon mched gsum la gtor ma gru gsum gtso 'khor gsum can mtheb ril gyis mtshan pa/ chad brtan sman raka gtor tshogs zhi drag gi nyer spyod sogs mchod pa bzang du bsham pa'o/ /de nas cho ga'i sbyor ba ni/ rgyas par sgrub mchod 'don zin ltar ram/ bsdu na rdo rje phag mo'i las byang 'bring po ltar/ brgyud 'debs nas mtshams bcad bar btang*/ sngon 'gro dang bcas pa'i rim gnyis rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ltar rdor sems/ maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bsnyen pa dang dbang blang ba bcas grub nas/ las byang gi byin 'bebs nas bzlas pa'i mjug stong tshig phul ba'i bar btang la/

rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i sgos dbang dkyus gcig tu bsgrub na/ tshe sgrub kyi lha bskyed nas bzlas pa tshe 'gugs rgyas gdab rjes smon shis brjod/ nor sgrub kyi khrus gsol nas bsnyen pa'i skabs/ thod rten yod na de nyid kyi byin 'bebs dang bzlas pa bya/ gang ltar yang gtor 'bul g.yang 'gugs rjes rtsa las kyi sngags dang shis pa brjod/ dbang sdud la lha bskyed nas bzlas pa'i thun mtshams khyad par gyi me mchod 'bul/ zor las la mdun dkyil bskyed bzlas srung zlog bsad pa'i dmigs bzlas khyug tsam re btang*/ zur gsal bka' srung mkha' 'gro mched gsum gyi gtor 'bul bya/ de nas las byang gi tshogs kyi skong ba grub mtshams/ mchod skong ltar rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i chu skong nas mar me'i skong ba grub kyi bar mthar chags su btang zhing so so'i byin rlabs brda dbang blangs/ mdos rag gi bskang ba ni gter las phab ma grub pas/ sa bcad mi stong tsam bsgrub pa la/ byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stong pa'i ngang las mdos gtor rnams/ /ngo bo ye shes rang bzhin la/ /rnam pa snang srid dkyil 'khor kun/ /yongs rdzogs mdos gtor nam mkha' mdzod/ /byed las lha tshogs dgyes skor gyur/ /ces dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/ hūm̐/ skye med dbyings kyi nam mkha'i klong*/ /rig gdangs ma 'gags cho 'phrul las/ /srid zhi'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lor shar/ /de dbus rdo rje khros ma nag /rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo yab yum dang*/ /las dang ye shes dhā ki nī/ /'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dgyes dgur spyod pa'i maṇ+ḍa la/ /bde chen rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /yongs rdzogs mdos kyi longs spyod mchog /'dod yon mchog gi gter chen pos/ /rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/

/dam tshig nyams chag zhi bar mdzod/ /nad rims 'byung bzhi'i g.yo 'khrugs zlog/ /tshe bsod 'khor slob brgyud 'dzin spel/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po'i 'tshe ba chod/ /nye rgyu'i spyod pa'i grogs mdzad nas/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i bar chad sol/ /zhu bde mi rtog ye shes skyed/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hi kro dhī kā lī ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya dhā ka dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bam̐ badz+ra bha ra hī dz+nyā na badz+ra maṇ+ḍal sarba pū dza ma ya hoḥ zhes btags pa ci nus bzlas pas mchod/ de ltar phul bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zag med kyi bde bas dgyes shing 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ bdag dang slob ma'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bsal zhing*/ mchog thun gyi las rab 'byams lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzad par gyur par bsam/ bdud rtsi ril sgrub ni/ rtsa dbang sgrub pa'i zhar byung du bdud rtsi'i pho brang la dmigs pas khyab par byas pas sa bcad tshang mod spro na 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros kyi gsung mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi phag mo khros ma'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i ngag 'don sbyar/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags dang*/ mchod skong ltar don bskang bya/ brda dbang tshang ba'am 'jug pa mdor bsdus sngon du 'gro bas dbang bzhi'i snying po tsam blangs nas slob ma 'jug par gnang ba zhu/ dbang dngos la/ slob ma la khrus bya/ bgegs gtor bsngo zhing bka' bsgo srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ 'o/ mkha' mthas gtugs pa'i mar gyur gyi 'gro ba thams cad 'phags bzhi'i skyed yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma kun tu bzang mo'i go 'phang la bdag kho nas dgod par bya/ de'i ched du mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen mor dbang bskur ba zab mo nod de/ lam mchog myur du 'grod pa'i gdams pa tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/

de la spyir rgyal ba mi'i seng ge'i bstan pa thams cad kyi mchog gam/ rtse mor gyur pa ni gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa/ de la'ang nang gses kyi dbye bsdu mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ 'dir ni gzhi'i dus na zab mo stong pa nyid chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur cing*/ lam dus su ye shes dam tshig las dang chos kyi phyag rgya rnams gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi snying po'am khyab byed du bzhugs shing*/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i 'bras bu stong nyid snying rje ye shes kyi snying po can chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i mkha' klong*/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi phyag rgya chen mo nyid rtogs byar gyur pa'i phyir/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi snying po rab mchog /grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi thugs kyis brnag pa'i lam mthar thug pa ni bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i tshul kho na yin/ de la'ang gsar rny-ing bka' gter gyi chu klung gi lam srol mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ 'dir zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i sgrub skor ji snyed cig byon pa thams cad kyi snying po'i yang bcud dam par gyur pa mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen mor dbang bskur ba'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de la 'di nyid kyi byung ba brjod pa nyung ngu zhig yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed pa'i phyir brjod na/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sngon tshe 'og min gsang chen zhing : ye shes rang snang pho brang du: dbyings kyi yum chen kun bzang mo: longs sku rdo rje phag mor bzhengs: chos nyid rang sgras gsang chen rgyud: dus gsum dus med rtag tu gsungs: bar du mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling : o rgyan rang byung dur khrod du: bcom ldan badz+ra wā rā his: pad+ma thod phreng bdag nyid la: rgyud lung man ngag gsang ba'i mdzod:

smin grol yongs su rdzogs par stsal: da lta don gyi rnal 'byor ma: bka' yi sdud po mtsho rgyal lcam: dhā ki 'bum gyi tshogs bcas la: bod yul grub pa'i gnas kyi mthil: dbang chen dgyes pa'i pho brang du: bdag nyid mtsho skyes rdo rje yis: rdo rje phag mo'i gsang ba che: rgyud kyi dgongs pa snying por dril: lung gi nges pas gtan la phab: man ngag lag len dmar khrid du: thugs ky-i nying khu brnag pa byin: rang rang nyams len mthar dbyung la: rin chen sa yi snying por sbos: nam zhig mkha' 'gros byin brlabs pa'i: rigs ldan bu mo sprel lo ma: sbas tshul jo mo'i ming can la: mkha' 'gro rnams kyis chos 'di gtad: byin rlabs rtogs pas rang bzhin grol: dus der gzhan don cher mi 'byung : 'brel tshad bde chen sa la sbyor: phung po lhag med byang chub thob: slar yang bod khams sdug pa'i dus: chos kyi rgyal po'i skye ba'i mtha': mtsho rgyal khyod kyis byin brlabs pa: sus kyang brtag par dka' ba yi: ma nges 'gro 'dul rig pa 'dzin: sgyu ma lta bu'i skyes bu zhig: mdo khams shar nas 'byung dang 'phrad: lo tsā chen po'i ye shes dang : gnyis min gnyis su snang ba'i tshul: sngags kyi gdung mtha' byang chub sems: blo gros mi zad gter la gtad: gnyis ka'i smon lam la brten nas: skal ldan 'ga' yi nyams chag sbyong : la la sngags kyi brtul zhugs spyod: 'ga' zhig bde chen ye shes rnyed: dngos grub dga' ston rgyas par 'gyur: zhes bslu ba med pa'i lung gis nges pas bstan pa bzhin/ yang dag don gyi 'og min na chos sku ye shes kyi dgongs pas rang snang gi 'khor la brjod tshig las 'das pa'i gsang rgyud rnams rang shar ba'i rol rtsal 'gags pa med par bstan/ rang byung mkha' spyod kyi zhing du longs sku brda'i phag mos ston pa nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor la rdo rje'i rgyud kyi gsang ba dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid du bshad/

o rgyan gyi dur khrod chen por sprul sku rtags kyi rdo rje phag mos bdag nyid chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la gdams/ 'jam dpal sprul pa'i rgyal po'i thugs bskyed dang kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i phrin las dus su smin pas bod yul mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me sbar ba'i skabs shig /rgyal kun 'dus zhal ma hā gu ru rin po ches rgyud lung man ngag snying por bsdus pa'i dmar khrid zab mo thugs kyi nying khu'i mnog chos/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi gdams skor 'di rnams bsam yas mchims phu'i nags kyi dur khrod chen por bka' yi bsdu ba gzungs ma mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la thugs dam gyi yang snying du stsal ba bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes shing*/ gu ru'i bka' bzhin ma 'ongs pa'i don la dgongs nas/ e bzang mo lung gi brag gu ru'i sgrub gnas bde chen gsang ba phug tu brda yig rigs lngar bris te/ nam zhig las can ma dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam dang bcas gter du sbas shing*/ gter bdag dur khrod kyi ma mo drag shul can spyang zhon mched gsum la bcol/ phyis rab byung bzhi pa'i nang du mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal nyid kyi rnam 'phrul rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma jo mo sman mo'am/ mtshan dngos pad+ma mtsho skyid du grags pa la mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mos gter dpe dngos su gtad cing byin gyis brlabs/ sbas tshul gyis 'gro don ci rigs mdzad pa las gzhan la rgya chere la ba'i skabs su ma babs shing*/ thugs nyams su rtse gcig bzhes pa la brten sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang brnyes pa'i zab chos ngo mtshar can byin rlabs kyi sprin phung 'phro ba yin cing*/ rmad du byung ba'i gsang ba chen po 'di nyid re zhig yang 'dab gter du sbas pa ye shes mkha' 'gro'i phyag tu bzhugs shing phal pa'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa/

rtsod dus kyi tha mar 'dul ba'i skabs su babs pa na/ thugs rje dang smon lam gyi dbang las gangs can mkhas grub gter ston thams cad kyi rgyal po/ sprul pa'i rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa la bka' babs pa ste/ rje 'di nyid ni ngo bo slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra dbyer med pa'i thugs rje'i rang gzugs su shar ba yin cing*/ gdul bya so so'i blo ngor 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen dril bu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros/ paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen la sogs pa dang bod yul du chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ gu ru chos dbang*/ ras chung rdor grags/ sa skya rje btsun grags rgyal/ grub chen thang rgyal/ lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med la sogs pa gsar rnying gi skyes chen dam pa du ma'i rnam par 'phrul par bstan pa/ rje nyid nas kyang rjes su dran pa dang*/ khyad par rgyal sras mchog grub rgyal po nyid gter 'byin rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum byon par gsungs pa'i thog mar sangs rgyas bla ma nas/ bcu gnyis pa chos rje gling pa'i bar byon zin nas/ bcu gsum pa rje 'di nyid yin par rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar mtshon pa dang*/ gter ston rgyal po lnga la bran brgyas bskor: zhes gsungs pa'i lnga pa mdo sngags gling pa ni/ mchog ldan mgon po yin par grags kyang*/ rten 'brel 'chol bas gter kha gang yang phyag tu ma 'byor zhing*/ glo bur du mdzad pa brtul bas/ rgyal po lnga pa ni rje 'di nyid kho nar grub pas phyi dus byon pa'i gter ston tshad ma thams cad 'di nyid kyi bran du grub pa'ang mngon sum gyis gsal zhing*/ rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag dam par gyur pa bka' babs kyi shing rta chen po bdun ldan du bzhugs pa las/ gsum pa yang gter gyi chos skor las byon pa nyid rdo rje'i lung gi nges pas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin/

gsang ba'i bdag po rnam snang lo tsā ba'i ye shes kyi rol mo dang gnyis su med kyang gnyis su snang ba'i zol can/ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po pad+ma gar dbang 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa dang chos bdag rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang sogs la bka' babs kyi gnyer kha stsal ba las brgyud de/ bdag cag gi skal ba bzang po'i dpyid du thob pa 'di nyid kyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho gas smin grol 'bogs pa'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de la'ang rtsa ba'i smin byed dang*/ byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang*/ yan lag gi dbang drug /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i sgos dbang*/ srung ma'i bka' gtad bcas 'byung ba las/ 'dir ni rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dbang srung ma'i bka' gtad bcas bgyi ba yin ste/ de'ang gsang ba sngags kyi rim pa ni ma smin pa smin par byed pa smin byed dbang gi mtha' can dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i gdams ngag khrid kyi mtha' can zhes yongs su grags pa las 'dir rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar/ rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi grol byed sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrid dang bcas pa stan thog gcig tu tshangs sprugs su bgyid pa la/ bdag gi bgyi bar 'os pa'i cho ga'i rim pa rnams legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la'ang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ thog mar dkyil 'khor phyi nang du 'jug pa'i smin grol zab mo'i bka' drin zhu ba'i yon du

sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ sngon chad lhan skyes kyi ma rig pas sgrib ste/ rang rig gi lha zhal mngon du ma gyur pa'i brdar ras yug dmar po kha tshar dang bcas pa'i gdong g.yogs 'ching bar zhu/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes thung ngur brjod/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor chen por phyag rten med par mjal du mi rung bas/ de'i dod du u dum wā ra'i me tog gi phreng ba re phyag tu thogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes ring por brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon la dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje btsun mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dngos yin snyam pa'i dag snang bskyed la thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rdo rje phag mo'i ye shes sku: slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol: mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag 'jug cing bsnyen sgrub spro: gsang ba'i dam tshig 'tshal lags na: smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba'i lan du spro ba bskyed cing gdams ngag 'bogs pa dang*/ gnang ba sbyin pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas gsang ba'i dam tshig srog las gces par bsrung dgos pas dam bsgrags pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor che: bka' gnyan mthu btsan byin rlabs myur: 'jug pa'i skal ldan shin tu dkon: 'on kyang dad dang brtson 'grus dang : brtul zhugs zab mo spyod nus na: gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: khyed rnams yongs su smin par bya: de phyir dam tshig srog ltar srungs: sa ma ya rāk+ṣan+tu: de nas dam tshig gi rdo rje'i mna' chu sbyin pa 'di nyid myangs nas/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang gsang ba bla med spyi dang*/ khyad par rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi sdom pa dang brtul zhugs kyi rim pa yal bar mi 'dor snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan por bzung zhing*/

de nyid yal bar mi 'dor ba'i blos rdo rje'i bro bor ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya i dan te na ra kan: de nas thog mar rgyud snod rung du bsgrub pa'i phyir skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ sdom bzung rnams rim par 'byung ba las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa len pa'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje phag mo la phyogs dus kyi dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho sprin gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar blo gtad ling bskyur/ ci mdzad khyed shes kyi 'dun pa dang bcas pas skyabs su 'gro ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bdag dang khams gsum 'gro ba kun: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: rtsa ba gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum ngang du gnas gyur cig: lan gsum/ des skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa legs par thob pas dgag sgrub cha mthun gyi bslab bya rnams la tshul bzhin slob pa dang*/ khyad par du dus drug gam bzhi la sogs par ji ltar nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag 'bogs pa la snyan gtad par zhu/ kye skal ldan rnams nyon cig: 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar bar byed pa la thog ma kho nar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos: de la gsang sngags bla na med pa'i skyabs yul thams cad bla ma la tshang ba yin te: rang nyid 'dug pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams chen por gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma nyi ma bam̐ ro'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje khros ma nag mo'i sku zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa ye shes kyi me phung 'bar zhing 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i klong na bzhugs par lam gyis gsal gdab: de nyid dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid: sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen por yid ches mos gus kyi gdung bas bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis 'dun pa gcig tu dril te ci mdzad khyed kho na mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos skyabs su 'gro ba lan brgya stong du ma'i bar du brjod:

slar yang mos 'dun shugs drag tu byas pas bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros: rang gzhan sems can thams cad la phog: sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag: skyabs gnas ma lus pa'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs: mthar 'od du zhu ba rang la thim par bsam la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du blo bzhag go /de ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i dmigs 'don nyams len gyi rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ mkha' khyab kyi ma rgan sems can thams cad la tshad med pa bzhi'i blos khyab par byas te/ de rnams kyi don du rdo rje btsun mo'i go 'phang myur du bsgrub par bya/ de'i slad du bskyed rdzogs gtso bor gyur pa'i zab lam la 'jug par bgyi'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug sems bskyed bzung ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gis sems can thams cad rnams: sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i phyir: mkha' 'gro ma yi bskyed bzlas dang : mchod bstod sgrub la brtson par bgyi: lan gsum/ des smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi sdom pa legs par thob pa yin pas/ de dag gi bslab bya spyi dang bye brag dkar nag gi chos bzhi bzhi'i blang dor dang sems can blos mi spang zhing*/ ci bgyi'i gzhan don du bslab pa la brtson dgos pas/ de'i tshul mdor dril nas nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag 'bogs pa la snyan gtad par zhu/ kye skal ba dang ldan pa rnams nyon cig: smon 'jug gi sems gzung nas de'i dmigs pa rgyun du yid la bya ba ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin pas 'di ltar bsam par bya ste: 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las rang nyid gcig pu thar bas mi phan: sems can thams cad pha ma drin can sha stag yin: de thams cad bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pas sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu 'bras la longs spyod pa snying re rje: 'di thams cad sdug bsngal cha dang bcas pa las grol ba'i phan bde bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bdag kho nas dgod pa'i slad du bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya dgos snyams pa dang :

de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de'ang spyir theg pa chen po'i lam la brten dgos: de'i nang nas kyang dus myur du tshegs chung ngus sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa ni gsang chen bla na med pa'i lam mchog 'di kho na yin pas rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam zab mo 'di la brten nas tshe gcig lus gcig kho nas bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas te sems can thams cad srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis ka la mi gnas pa'i byang chub mchog gi sa la dgod par bgyi'o snyam du yang nas yang du bsam zhing tshig gis gsal gdab/ ci byed gzhan don du 'gyur ba la bslab par bya'o/ de ni sems bskyed pa'i dmigs rim dang bslab bya'i nyams len mdor dril ba'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa bzung ba ni/ zhing mchog de rnams dpang por gsol ba'i spyan sngar/ deng nas gnyis med byang chub kyi sa la ma phyin gyi bar du so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa ma lus pa gzung*/ srog dang longs spyod kyang btang nas tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i g.yar dam gyi ri mo snying la bkod de 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ho: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir: so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba dang : byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang : rig 'dzin gsang sngags sdom pa'i tshogs: tshul bzhin bzung zhing bsrung bar bgyi: lan gsum/ des so byang sngags kyi sdom pa rnams cho ga'i sgo nas thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad phyi so thar/ nang byang sems/ gsang ba rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa rnams ngo bo ma 'dres par bzung*/ yon tan yar ldan du bsgrub/ dus skabs dgos pas gtso bor spyod cing*/ nyes pa'i dri ma'i cha shas kyis ma gos par dran shes kyis bsrung ba dang*/ nyams chags kyi nyes pa rnams phyir bcos dang tshogs bsags la brten nas gtsang bar byed dgos pa'i tshul snying por bsdus te nyams su len bya'i gdams ngag 'bogs pa 'di la snyan gtad par zhu/

kye skal ba dang ldan pa rnams nyon cig: rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bslab pa rnams kyis sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung dgos: gal te dam tshig nyams chag gi skyon cung zad byung yang bshags sdom bya ba dang : spyir yang nyams rtogs skye ba'i 'gal rkyen sdig ltung sbyang ba dang : mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa'i thabs la sgo du ma nas 'bad dgos pas thog mar rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la brten nas sdig ltung sbyong ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab pa ni: āḥ bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng : drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid: rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: snyems ma gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung gis: ye shes 'od zer klong na bzhugs: thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ dkar gsal: yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor: bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi: gsung gi byin rlabs 'dus par bsam: zhes sdig ltung bshags pa'i rten gsal btab nas: sngar byas kyi nyes pa la gnong 'gyod dang : phyin chad mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems drag pos: oṃ: bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems: mgon med bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag gis tshe rabs thog med nas: tha ma da ltar thug gi bar: sdig ltung las rnams ci bsags kun: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags: phyin chod mi bgyid dam bca' na: dag tshangs chen po'i dngos grub stsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya nar gyis babs: sbyor mtshams nas byung : rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs: lus kyi nang thams cad gang : nad gdon sdig ltung thams cad lhag med du sbyangs par bsams la yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla: mthar sdig sgrib dag pa'i gnang ba byin nas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rang nyid la thim par bsam la rig pa spro bsdu med pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go:

de lta bu de thun du bcad la rtags ma byung bar nyams su blang : rgyun du'ang ma chag par gyis shig: de ni 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong byed bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid rim mo/ /de nas tshogs bsags pa'i slad maṇ+ḍal dbul bar bya ste: mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs zhing bla ma rdo rje phag mor skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar rang gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum gus pas 'khod par mos: mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i maṇ+ḍal byi dor legs par bya: dri lngas chag chag gdab: rin chen 'bru sman la sogs pa'i tshom bu dgod cig ngag tu: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ri rab gling bzhi mu khyud bcas: stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing : 'dod rgu'i 'byor tshogs bsam mi khyab: bla ma sprul pa'i sku la 'bul: phung po khams dang skye mched kun: rang byung lhun grub yid bzhin gter: bkod pa tshad med yon tan rgyan: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs la 'bul: dbyings nyid gdod nas rnam par dag: rig pa mi 'gyur 'od lngar shar: 'khor 'das kun khyab mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma chos kyi sku la 'bul: bla ma sku gsum lha tshogs rnams: zag med bde bas rab mnyes nas: bdag dang sems can thams cad kun: tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza ho: zhes phyi snod bcud kyi 'byor pa: nang rang lus phung khams: gsang ba dbyings rig dbyer med maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du phul bas bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyis dgyes pa chen pos bdag gir mdzad: rang gzhan sems can thams cad sku gsum zhing khams rgya mtsho la longs spyod pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi sa bon thebs par bsam: mthar tshogs zhing rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim par mos: don dam ye shes kyi ngang du mnyam par gzhag: de ltar dus dang rgyun du nyams su blang ba la brtson par gyis shig: de ni thun mong gi tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i dmigs khrid kyi rim pa'o/

/slar yang bden gnyis dbyer med lhag pa'i byang chub kyi sems gsang sngags nang gi man ngag ltar bskyed pa'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa'i gdan la don dam byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po mi 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin mtshon byed rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'greng thabs su gnas pa gsal btab ste/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa bden gnyis dbyer med byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i rnal 'byor du bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta u pa dā yā mi/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar reg pas/ sems bskyed pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ 'di lta bu'i gsang sngags kyi cho ga zab mo rnams kyi tshul skal med rnams la rlung phyogs tsam yang mi bsgrags par gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: dam tshig nyams dang med pa la: nam yang smra bar bya ba min: tshul min smras na nyams par 'gyur: gu h+ya sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu: de rnams kyis phyi 'jug gi rim pa rnams grub nas/ gnyis pa nang 'jug la sbyor dngos rjes 'brel bcas pa rim pa bzhin du sgrub pa la/ thog mar khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo 'gram du 'khod pa'i mos pas/ slob dpon sgo srung dang bcas pa la sgo dbye bar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ho: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi nas: tshad med bzhi ldan mkha' 'gro mas: rnam thar bzhi yi sgo phyes la: sku bzhi'i ye shes bstan du gsol: dz+nyā na dhā ki nī sa ma ya hūm̐: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas tshad med pa bzhi'i 'od zer 'phros dkyil 'khor gyi sgo la phog pas sgo rnams phyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/

dbye ba'i rgya dang*/ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la pra be sha ya phaṭa: lan bzhi/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis bye ba la khyed rang rnams shar sgo nas bzung g.yon bskor gyis byang la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi'i phyi nas slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs la sku gsung thugs kyis phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa dang bcas te thal mo gnas gsum du sbyor la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor pa'i: sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ni: bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes tshul: mngon sum mthong phyir phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī sarba maṇ+ḍa la dz+nyā na kā ya wā ka tsit+ta na mā mi:

lan bzhis phyag byar gzhug /slar yang shar sgo'i thad du khyed rang rnams zhing chen gyi gdan la he ru ka'i chas kyis brgyan te 'khod par gyur pa la nan tan gyi sgo nas dam tshig gi gnad la bkar zhing khe nyen gyi don bsgrags nas/ bsrung 'das kyi dpang por rdo rje btsun mo'i byang chub kyi sems lce thog tu bzhag pa 'di nyid snying dbus ye shes sems dpa' dang ro gcig tu 'dres nas/ dam tshig nyams na bka'i chad pas dmyal mes bsregs shing*/ bsrung na bde ba chen po'i dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas su bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nang mchod sbyin la/ ho: 'di ni dngos grub mchog gi rgyu: rdo rje phag mo'i byang sems te: nyams na 'bar ba'i me yis sreg: bsrungs na bde chen ye shes 'grub: bam̐ a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha: de ltar byin pa'i byang sems kyi bdud rtsi de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar bam̐ yig gi rnam par gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros: rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs rnams byin thibs se byon par bsams la dad gus gdung shugs rtse gcig tu bskyed mdzod cig /hūm̐ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling : pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi rje: rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dpa' bo dhā ki'i tshogs dang bcas: rang bzhin dbyings nas sku skyod cig: sku yi gar stabs shigs se shig: gsung gi dzab sgra 'u ru ru: thugs kyi ye shes lams se lam: rdo rje'i me 'od lhabs se lhab: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: skal ldan rnams kyi bag chags sreg: nyams chags rtog sgrib thams cad sbyongs: ma bcos spros med 'od gsal dang : khyab gdal chen po'i byin chen phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ dang hūm̐ gi glu mang du gyer/ gsum pa nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes kyi byin dbab pa ni/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa dang*/

slob dpon dbyer med pa'i sku las ye shes kyi 'od zer me lce lta bu byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs: rnam par shes pa'i dwangs ma bam̐ yig mthing gar gyur pa de nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi zhal du drangs: thugs kar bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu: sku yi dbyibs brgyud: gsang ba'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa sbyor mtshams nas phyir spros te gdan la 'khod pa las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar rnam thar gsum ldan gyi chos 'byung bsnol ma dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar pad+ma dang nyi ma bam ro'i steng du sems nyid bde stong ye shes kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i gri gug bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las bde ba chen po'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus te thim pa las/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis phag mo khros ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dus kyi mun pa ltar nag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ khro chags sgeg pa'i gzi byin 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bhan+dha khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo g.yon du yab he ru ka yi ngo bor gyur pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ ral pa dmar nag gyen du 'khyil zhing*/ rna ltag g.yon du phag zhal gyis mtshan pa las rdo rje'i ngur sgras sa gsum g.yo ba/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ thod skam lnga yis dbur brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas gar stabs kyis ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na srid zhi'i kun gyi spyi dpal chen por gsal ba'i/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing gas mtshan pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de nas slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi sprin chen mkha' khyab tu spros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad mkha' 'gro gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sad cing snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi byin chen rgyud la phebs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'bebs rdzas btul zhing*/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig bla ma yi dam lha: dgongs shig gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam tshig gsang ba'i brdas bskul na: thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin sku gsum zhing khams nas: rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: zhi khro 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod sa spyod gnas yul nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: bka' nyan dam tshig dkyil 'khor nas: chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes pho brang nas: rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag: 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs: 'od gsal chen po'i dngos grub stsol: me long ye shes pho brang nas: 'gyur med rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag 'khor dang = ka dag chen po'i dngos= mnyam nyid ye shes pho brang nas: rtsol med rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag 'khor dang = khyab brdal chen po'i dngos= sor rtog ye shes pho brang nas: chags med pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag 'khor dang = bde ba chen po'i dngos= bya grub ye shes pho brang nas: thogs med karma mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag= lhun grub chen po'i= phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po nas: phra men dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma: 'bum phrag= las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas: thabs shes dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: gnas yul dag pa'i zhing du sgyur: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur:

rnal 'byor pho mo'i nyams rtogs spor: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: rtsa rlung thig le'i nyams chag sbyongs: mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub dang : gnas skabs thun mong phrin las sgrubs: ma g.yel ma g.yel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs rje thugs dam dus la bab: glog ltar myur ba'i ye shes kyis: mngon sum byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bam̐ ha ri ni sa sarba dhā ki nī maṇ+ḍa la e h+ye hi: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a āḥ ra ra ra ra: tsa la ya tsa la ya: hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ: drag tu bzlas pas byin dbab/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ byin dbab pa'i lha tshogs khyed rang rnams la dbyer med du thim par mos mdzod/ de ltar byas pas byin phebs pa'i rtags ni/ gzhung las/ lus kyi ba spu gzings pa dang : 'jigs pa'i zil dang : bde ba'i nyams dang : gnas dang rten rnams byin thibs se 'ong bar 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs pa'i byin rlabs de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag pas byang chub snying po'i bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dz+nyā na badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: gsum pa rjes 'brel rnams rim par 'byung ba las/ rigs kyi lha'i skal ba brtag pa'i slad du phyag rten 'bul ba ni/ sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngon nas las kyis 'brel zhing*/ dngos grub dang phrin las myur du 'grub pa'i rigs kyi lhas bzhes su gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ hoḥ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rig pa'i me tog 'di phul bas: sngon nas las 'brel bzhag pa'i lha: gang yin de la 'bab par shog: dz+nyā na puṣ+pe sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de ltar phul ba'i me tog gang la babs kyang gtso mo lhan cig skyes ma'i ye shes kyi rol pa las gzhan du ma g.yos kyang*/

rnam pa tha dad du snang ba tsam du shes pas khyed rang rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa de nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzung ba dang*/ me tog de nyid rigs kyi lha'i phyag gis blangs te dbang rtags cod pan gyi tshul du spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hoḥ 'di ni khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha: bcom ldan rdo rje btsun mo ste: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: byin gyis brlab phyir dbang bskur ro: oṃ dz+nyā na dhā ki nī puṣ+pe a bhi ṣiñca mi: slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas thugs rje'i 'od zer gser gyi thur ma lta bu byung bas/ ma rig gnyis 'dzin bag chags kyi sgrib g.yogs mig ras dang lhan cig bsal bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hoḥ ma rig pa yi ling tog ni: rig pa mchog gi thur mas bsal: ye shes chen po'i mig thob pas: rang byung dkyil 'khor mthong gyur cig: dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥhūm̐ āḥ de ltar ye shes kyi mig gsar du thob pas rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i don gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bzhugs tshul ji bzhin pa de nyid/ mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor 'di la brten nas mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ kye ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyod ni ye shes byin rlabs zhugs: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ltos la: mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub par gyis: kye rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig: 'di na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te: sku mtshan ma: gsung bdud rtsi: thugs sin+dhū ra: ye shes rdo rje sems dpa'i me long gi dkyil 'khor rnams dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngo bo yum lnga'i mkha' klong 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi steng du rdo rje'i srung 'khor dur khrod brgyad rab tu 'jigs pa'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje khros ma nag mo: phyogs bzhir snying po'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: bar khyams su gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro: sgo dang gru chad rnams su phra men dang dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang dbyer mi phyed par bzhugs pa mngon sum du mthong zhing :

de thams cad kyang rtsa rlung thig le sems dang bcas pa gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin can du ye nas rang rang la bzhugs pa yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: de ltar brda dang rtags kyi dpes mtshon byed du byas nas/ mtshon bya rang byung rig pa gzhi rdzogs byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor chen po blta mthong gi yul las brgal ba de nyid mngon du gyur pa la ched du brjod pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs: dam tshig dkyil 'khor chen po mthong : ye shes dkyil 'khor mngon sum phyir: skal ba mchog tu da gyur to: dz+nyā na sa ma ya ho ho ho: de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs nas rdo rje bzhi'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug pa'i cho ga zab mo yang gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying por gyur pa de nyid legs par thob pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i rim pa nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag sbyin pa 'di la snyan gtad par zhu/ kye skal ba dang ldan pa rnams nyon cig: rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na yin: de'ang smin byed dbang gi skabs su bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas ye shes dbab cing byin gyis brlabs pas mtshon te sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dngos su sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi rgyun gsos btab pa'i slad du myur lam zab mo bsgom pa la thog mar rten bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang lus der 'dzin med pa'i ngang : snang srid rnam dag 'og min zhing : bkod pa tshad med yon tan rdzogs: mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' zer klong : seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang : he ru ka dpal pad+ma 'byung : dmar smug rnal 'byor spyod pa'i tshul: snang srid zil gnon gzi brjid 'bar: phyag gnyis rdo rje thod zhal bsnams: gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ bsgrengs: dar gyi na bza' rin chen rgyan: rus rgyan stag sham dril g.yer 'khrol:

thod skam dbu rgyan ral pa'i rtser: rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mtshan: spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur 'khyil: zhal ras khro 'dzum gzi brjid 'bar: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur: zhes gsal btab la: rang bzhan sems can thams cad kyis kha tsam min pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs par bsams la ngag tu: oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan bla ma la: sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: lus dang longs spyod ltos med mchod sprin 'bul: sdig ltung dam tshig nyams chag mthol zhing bshags: zag bcas zag med dge la rjes yi rang : snying po don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: rtag par mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba kun: 'gro rnams bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo: e ma ho: ngo bo blo 'das 'od gsal chos kyi sku: rang bzhin zung 'jug ye shes longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje 'gro 'dul sprul sku pad+ma 'byung : sku gsum dbyer med drin chen bla ma la: mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs: mgon med bdag la re ltos khyed las med: thugs rjes gzigs shig 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol: zhes mos gus kyis gdung ba drag pos thugs rgyud bskul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes rtse gcig tu bsnyen: mthar dbang blang ba ni: mkha' khyab sku gsum dbyer med rdo rje 'chang : ye shes mchog gi thugs rje'i shugs phyung la: 'od zer chen po'i cho 'phrul rmad byung bas: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim dang cig car du byung ba rang gi gnas gsum du rim dang cig car du zhugs shing th-im:

dbang bzhi'i nus pa rgyud la smin: mthar bla ma bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu: rang la thim pas rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje khros ma nag mo'i skur gyur par bsams la thugs yid bsres te bla ma chos sku'i rang zhal blta ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag: 'di ni lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dus rtag tu nyams su len par gyis shig: de rnams kyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa grub nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba la/ sbyang bya gnas skabs bzhi'i rim pa dang mthun par sbyong byed phyi/ nang*/ gsang ba/ de kho na nyid de dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhi rim par 'byung ba las/ dang po phyi bum pa'i dbang la'ang phung po lnga la bdag tu zhen pa'i ma rig pa sbyang nas/ de nyid ye shes sku lnga'i rang bzhin du rtogs shing smin par byas pas rang rgyud la phan 'dogs pa phan pa'i dbang ngam slob ma'i dbang dang*/ thugs gsung sku'i mkha' 'gro'i 'khor los sgo gsum la byin gyis brlabs pa las bdag gzhan gyi don bsgrub nus par byed pa nus pa'i dbang ngam slob dpon gyi dbang*/ lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lor dag pas lha dang skal ba mnyam par byed pa nus pa mchog gi dbang bcas rim par 'byung ba rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje 'chang chen pos: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la: dbang bskur ji ltar stsal ba bzhin: bdag kyang rjes su gzung mdzad gsol:

lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa sngon du song nas/ dang po phan pa'i dbang gi slad du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su med pa'i thugs rje'i rlabs g.yos te/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' lcam dral/ mchod lha/ sgo skyong gi tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams la slob bur dbang bskur ba'i don du mchod cing bstod de gsol ba gdab pa ni slob dpon gyis bgyi ba lags te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā sa mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ ces bstod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum lngas rang byung bde stong gi bum pa ye shes lnga'i chu rgyun gyis gang bas spyi bo'i gnas lngar dbang bskur/ sems dpa' dang sems ma rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ mchod lha rnams kyis mchod cing mnga' dbul/ sgo srung khro bo khro mos bgegs bskrad pa dang bcas te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ: snod ni chos dbyings ye shes klong : bcud ni rdo rje khros ma che: snod bcud yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas: bde gshegs rigs su lhun grub shog: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā he kro dhī kā lī a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: hūm̐: snod ni me long ye shes klong : bcud ni badz+ra dhā ki nī: snod bcud= rdo rje'i rigs su lhun grub shog: oṃ ha badz+ra dhā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: trām̐: snod ni mnyam nyid ye shes klong : bcud ni rat+na dhā ki nī: snod bcud=

rin chen rigs su lhun grub shog: oṃ ri rat+na dhā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca trām̐: hrīḥ snod ni sor rtog ye shes klong : bcud ni pad+ma dhā ki nī: snod bcud= pad+ma'i rigs su lhun grub shog: oṃ ni pad+ma dhā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ āḥ snod ni bya grub ye shes klong : bcud ni karma dhā ki nī: snod bcud= las kyi rigs su lhun grub shog: oṃ sa karma dhā ki nī a bhi ṣiñca āḥ bcud kyang sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun spyi bo'i gnas lnga nas zhugs: nyon mongs pa lnga bde chen du dag: phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gnas gyur: chu bo'i rba rlabs spyi bor brtan pa las he ru ka rigs lngas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni phan pa slob ma'i dbang ngo*/ /gnyis pa nus pa slob dpon gyi dbang gi slad du/ slar yang bhan+dha snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo rnams su bzhag pas lha tshogs rnams kyi rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pas/ phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub par nus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs kyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas: yid la mngon par dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i thugs su 'grub par shog: oṃ sarba dhā ki nī tsit+ta dz+nyā na āt+ma ko3 haṃ: mgrin par bzhag cing bdud rtsi sbyin la/ āḥ ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung gi rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas: ngag la mngon par dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i gsung du 'grub par shog: oṃ sarba dhā ki nī wā ka dz+nyā na āt+ma ko3 haṃ: spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku yi rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas: lus la mngon par dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog: oṃ sarba dhā ki nī kā ya dz+nyā na āt+ma ko3 haṃ: de ltar dbang bskur bas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi thugs gsung sku'i gsang ba dang slob ma'i sgo gsum dbyer med par gyur te rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i go 'phang la dbang bsgyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

de ni nus pa slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /gsum pa nus pa mchog gis dbang bskur ba la sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa re 'phros pas gtso mo rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i sku spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga /lte ba/ gsang gnas te gnas lnga dang*/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams lus kyi rtsa gnas so so/ phra men ma bzhi yan lag bzhi/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dpung mgo gnyis dang pus mo gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams khyed rang rnams la thim zhing*/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gnas so sor bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje khros ma'i sku spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rigs kyi pho brang nas: bcom ldan rdo rje khros ma yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chos dbyings ye shes sku 'grub shog: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā he kro dhī kā lī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi pho brang nas: bcom ldan badz+ra mkha' 'gro mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: me long ye shes sku 'grub shog: oṃ ha badz+ra dhā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku lte bar bzhag la/ hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi pho brang nas: bcom ldan rat+na dhā ki nīs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mnyam nyid ye shes sku 'grub shog: oṃ ri rat+na dha ki nī kā ya ā bhi ṣiñca mi: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sku mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi pho brang nas: bcom ldan pad+ma dha ki nīs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sor rtog ye shes sku 'grub shog: oṃ ni pad+ma dhā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sku gsang bar bzhag la/ hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi pho brang nas: bcom ldan karma dhā ki nīs:

skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bya grub ye shes sku 'grub shog: oṃ sa karma dhā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi'i sku gnas so sor bzhag la: hūm̐: smin mtshams pul+li ra ma lar: thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la pra tsaṇ+ḍa kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: ltag pa'i gnas mchog arbu dar: mche ba rnam gtsigs sna chen ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ daṃṣ+ta ma hā nā sā kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: rna ba g.yas pa au ḍī yar: kaṅkal dang 'od ldan ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ kaṅkā la pra bhā wa tī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: spy-i gtsug dzā lan+dha ra ru: ma hā kaṅka gtum mig ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā kaṅka tsaṇ+ḍa ak+ṣi kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: rna ba g.yon pa go dā war: su ra wī ra blo can ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ su ra wī ra ma tī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: smin dbus ra me shwa ra ru: 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ a mi ta bhā kharga rī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: mig gnyis de bī ko ṭi ru: rdo rje'i 'od can laṅka ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra bhā laṅke shwa ri kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: phrag pa'i gnas mchog ma la yar: rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kā ya dru ma ts+tsha kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: mchan gnyis kā ma rū pa ru: aṅka ri dang e rā wa:

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ aṅku ri e rā wa tī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: sna rtse'i gnas mchog ko sa lar: rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thung ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra su ra bhak+ṣī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: lte ba tri sha ku ne ru: dpa' bo chen mo rlung shugs ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā bī ra wā yu be gī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: nu ma gnyis gnas o ṭe ru: rdo rje ral can 'jigs byed ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā dzā ṭī ma hā bhai ra wī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: kha yi gnas mchog ka liṅkar: rab tu bzang po sh+yā ma de: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ su bha dra sh+yā ma de wī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: mgrin pa'i gnas mchog lam+ba kar: rdo rje bzang po shin tu bzang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra bha dra su bha dra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: snying ga'i gnas mchog kāñci ru: 'jigs byed chen po rta rna ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā bhai ra wa ha ya kar+ṇi kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: 'dom bar hi mā la ya ru: rig mi bzang dang kha gā na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣa kha gā na nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: mtshan ma pre ta pu ri ru: stobs chen 'khor lo'i shugs 'chang ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā pā la tsakra be gī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: byin pa su bar+ṇā dī par:

nam snying 'khor lo'i go cha ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ kha gar+bha tsakra warmi ṇī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: brla gnyis sau'u rāṣ+ta ru: dpa' bo rta mgrin shauṇ+ḍi ni: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ha ya grī ba shauṇ+ḍi nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: bshang lam gri ha de ba ru: rin chen rdo rje dum skyes ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ rat+na badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro hā kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: sor mo bcu drug nā ga rar: he ru ka dang shin tu dpa': dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ he ru ka su bī rī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: bol gong gnas mchog sin+hū'i grong : pad+ma gar dbang stobs chen ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ pad+ma nirtī shwa ra ma hā bā lā kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: mthe bong bzhi gnas ma ru tar: rnam par snang mdzad 'khor sgyur ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ bai ro tsa na tsakra warti nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: pus mo'i gnas mchog ku lu tar: rdo rje sems dpa' brtson chen ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra sa twa ma hā bir+ya kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: phra men ma bzhi yan lag bzhir bzhag la: hūm̐: byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid: phra men chen mo khra gdong mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: zhi ba'i las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ kā kā mu khī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: snying rje tshad med ngo bo nyid: phra men chen mo phag gdong mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas rgyas pa'i las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ sū ka rā mu khī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi:

hūm̐: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid: phra men chen mo khyi gdong mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang gi las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ shwa na mu khī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid: phra men chen mo 'ug gdong mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: drag po'i las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ u lū ka mu khī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro bzhi dpung mgo gnyis dang pus mo gnyis su bzhag la: hūm̐: dga' ba'i ye shes ngo bo nyid: dam tshig mkha' 'gro gsher byed mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bde chen ye shes g.yo bar shog: oṃ dza la dhā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñcā mi: hūm̐: mchog tu dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid: dam tshig mkha' 'gro brtan byed mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bde chen ye shes 'bar= oṃ s+thā na dhā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: khyad par dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid: dam tshig mkha' 'gro sreg byed mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bde chen ye shes thim par shog: oṃ dz+wa la dhā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: hūm̐: lhan skyes dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid: dam tshig mkha' 'gro g.yo byed mas: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bde chen ye shes mthar phyin shog: oṃ tsa la na dhā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: zhes rim pa ltar gnas so sor bstim mo: des khams gsum gyi snang ba thams cad dang : rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i lha tshogs su rnam par dag pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya ba la 'bad par gyis shig /gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sku gsung thugs kyi gsang sngags rnams rim par byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas lnga'i khros ma rigs lnga'i thugs klong nyi zla'i gwa'u'i sbubs thugs srog bam̐ dang*/

ha ri ni sa'i yi ge mthing dkar ser dmar ljang gu so so'i mthar 'khod par mos te bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab par spyan drangs shing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob pas lus la gzi brjid/ ngag la nus pa/ yid la ye shes kyi rtsal phyogs med du 'bar bar mos te/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ bam̐ badz+ra bhā rā he kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya: lan gsum/ oṃ bam̐ badz+ra bai ro tsā nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa:

lan gsum/ oṃ bam̐ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: lan gsum/ slar yang mdun gyi mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng so so'i mdog mtshungs byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i thugs srog gi mthar 'khod pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis ma rig pa'i sdig sgrib zhi ba dang*/ ye shes rgyas pa/ rlung sems dbang du 'dus shing*/ gzung 'dzin bsgral ba sogs mchog gi las bzhi'i dngos grub dang*/ phrin las thams cad thogs med du mdzad par mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ha badz+ra dhā ki nī hūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ ri rat+na dhā ki nī trām̐: lan gsum/ oṃ ni pad+ma dhā ki nī hrī: lan gsum/ oṃ sa karma dhā ki nī phaṭa: lan gsum/ yang dkyil 'khor pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob ma'i lus dkyil gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyer bzhi po'i thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs kyi sa bon hūm̐ mthing ga /gsung gi lha tshogs la āḥdamar po/ sku'i lha tshogs la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa'i mthar so so'i sngags rnams 'khod pa/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad sbyangs shing*/ byin dbang dngos grub ma lus pa thob par dmigs la 'di dag gi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ tsit+ta tsakra pu dza o ā go ra de mā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lan gsum/ oṃ wā ka tsakra ka o tri ko ka la ka hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lan gsum/ oṃ kā ya tsakra pre gṛ so su nā si ma ku hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lan gsum/ yang dkyil 'khor pa'i las dang dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus dkyil gyi mkha' 'gro las kyi phra men ma so so'i thugs kar nyi zla'i sbubs su sa bon dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbazhi dang*/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i sa bon hūm̐ yig bzhi'i mthar bskor du 'khod pa de nyid bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis/

de rnams las 'od zer spro zhing bsdus pa la brten nas zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa'i thun mong gi phrin las rnams lhun gyis grub par mos la sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba karma sa ma ya dhā ki nī hūm̐: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: lan gsum/ oṃ sarba karma sa ma ya dhā ki nī hūm̐: bh+rūm̐ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: lan gsum/ oṃ sarba karma sa ma ya dhā ki nī hūm̐: hrīḥwā shaṃ ku ru ho: lan gsum/ oṃ sarba karma sa ma ya dhā ki nī hūm̐: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: lan gsum/ des sgra skad thams cad ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i gsung du rnam par dag pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya ba la 'bad par gyis shig /gsum pa thugs 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa ngo sprad cing don gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ khyed rang rnams rang byung ka dag don gyi dgongs pa brjod bral chos sku'i rig pa rjen pa'i ngang du yid dpyod kyis bslad ma zhugs pa'i dgongs nyams skyong bzhin du rdo rje'i tshig 'di la snyan gtad 'tshal/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes de: rang rig dri med stong pa yin: stong nyid dgongs pa mngon gyur na: rdo rje phag mo logs na med: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: me long lta bu'i ye shes de: rang rig gsal ba'i mdangs 'od yin: 'od gsal dgongs pa mngon gyur na: rdo rje mkha' 'gro logs na med: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes de: rang rig dus gsum 'gyur med yin: khyab gdal dgongs pa mngon gyur na: rin chen mkha' 'gro logs na med: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes de: rang rtsal sna tshogs snang ba yin: ma 'dres dgongs pa mngon gyur na: pad+ma mkha' 'gro logs na med: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes de: rang rig lhun gyis grub pa yin: mtha' bral dgongs pa mngon gyur na:

las kyi mkha' 'gro logs na med: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: ngo bo stong pa phag mo yum: rang bzhin gsal ba mkha' 'gro bzhi: thugs rje'i rig rtsal sprul pa'i sku: dam tshig las kyi mkha' 'gro dang : gnas yul dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: ma 'gags rang shar cir yang snang : skye ba med la 'gag pa med: gnas med dmigs med 'gro 'ong med: rnam thar gsum gyi bdag nyid can: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lor rdzogs: oṃ sarba dz+nyā na dhā ki nī dharma dhā tu a a a: brjod la chos nyid blo 'das kyi dbyings su cung zad mnyam par bzhag /des ni rtog tshogs thams cad ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i thugs su rnam par dag pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya ba la 'bad par gyis shig /de ltar na sku mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob: 'dod khams dang lus kyi dri ma dag: rdo rje phag mo'i sku bsgom pa la dbang zhing 'bras bu sku rdo rje mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du nges shes bskyed mdzod/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur rjes 'brel dang bcas pa legs par thob nas/ snod bcud tha mal du 'dzin pa'i zhen pa zlog byed bum pa'i dbang gi lam sku rdo rje bskyed rim sprul pa'i sku'i nyams len grol byed kyi gdams khrid 'di la snyan gtad 'tshal/ kye rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba ni dbang bskur ba yin la: dbang don gyi ye shes gsos 'debs par byed pa ni so so'i lam khyer la bslab par bya dgos: de la dang po bum dbang gi lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la gsum ste: thun mong gi bskyed rim: khyad par gyi bskyed rim: zhar byung bzlas pa'i rim pa'o: dang po ni: phrin las nas ji ltar 'byung ba'i sbyor ba rnams tshul bzhin du bya: dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis gzhi bzung : rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom:

dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems bzung : de'ang thog mar rang nyid gtso mo gcig pu'i gsal snang la blo bzhag: cung zad sems zin pa na spyan dbus ma nas bzung sku'i cha shas re re nas gsal snang mthar 'don: de bzhin du phyag mtshan gri gug: thod khrag: kha ṭ+wām̐ ga: rus pa'i phyag rgya: thod skam gyi dbu rgyan: thod rlon gyi do shal: rdo rje'i phag zhal: sku'i nyams 'gyur: gsung gi gdangs skad: thugs kyi dgongs pa: ye shes kyi me 'od: pad nyi ro gdan sogs rgyan gyi bye brag la sems gzung : de'ang las dang po pas: mdun du bris sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsham: de nyid lha dngos su bsam: yid mig rlung gsum mdung tshugs su gtad: gsal snang khyad par can shar ba na mdun gyi lha rang la bstim: rang nyid de lta bu'i lha skur gsal btab cing sems bzung : skabs rer brjod tshig gi sgo nas kyang gsal snang 'don: skabs rer dmigs pa rtse gcig pas sems gzung ngo : gtso mo'i sku la sems zin pa'am: de tsam ma zin kyang rung ste: skabs su rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po bya: res 'ga' rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje phag mo'i gsang ba gsum du shar ba de nyid kyang : don dam par sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i yon tan: kun rjob tu gzugs sku zhal phyag gi rnam par shar ba yin no snyam du dag pa dran: gtso mo la sems zin nas: rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro: dpa' bo dang dpa' mo: phrin las dang dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro: rten gzhal yas khang me ri'i bar re re bzhin du sems gzung : gsal snang skyes pa na: rten dang brten pa phyi nas nang : nang nas phyi: rags pa phra ba: nges pa: ma nges pa sogs sna tshogs su rtsal sbyang : mthar gyis snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lor 'char ba la bslab: bying rgod kyi skyon bsal: le lo'i 'phrang bcad:
